flash_692532.description: In an operational update, CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper says US forces cleared Iranian sea mines from Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes amid an ongoing naval blockade.

flash_692531.description: More than 50,000 people attend Selichot service at the Western Wall, bringing the total number of participants since the start of Elul to over 350,000.

flash_692530.description: "You shall rejoice in all the good that Hashem, your God, has given you..."

flash_692528.description: President Trump rejects reports he wants talks with Iran, saying Tehran is “begging to make a deal" as the US focuses on economic pressure.

flash_692526.description: President Trump signs an order renaming Lake Ontario “Lake America" in the US as Washington and Ottawa impose retaliatory tariffs in a trade war.

flash_692524.description:
A four-year-old boy was taken to Soroka Hospital in serious condition after he was apparently stung by a yellow scorpion in Arad.

Magen David Adom teams treated the boy and transported him to the hospital.

flash_692568.description:
The death of a seven-year-old boy who drowned in a lake at a park in south Tel Aviv has been confirmed.

The boy was located earlier in very serious condition after rescue forces conducted searches for him at the site and performed CPR on him.

flash_692567.description:
The IDF carried out a targeted airstrike a short time ago against several terrorists in Jenin, in the Menashe Regional Brigade area.

A security official said that three terrorists were inside the targeted vehicle.

The main target of the strike was a terrorist identified as the head of a terror network in Jenin, along with two additional accomplices who were working to advance terrorist attacks.

flash_692565.description: Israel did not grow strong because it had an American alliance. It acquired an American alliance because it had grown strong. Opinion.

flash_692564.description:
A source close to Hezbollah told the Saudi Al Arabiya network that the terror organization will not retreat from the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, where dozens of terrorists are estimated to be hiding underground, or hand it over to the Lebanese Armed Forces.

The source warned that the organization will engage in the confrontation if Israel decides to storm its positions on the ridge.

flash_692563.description: IDF strikes in Gaza eliminate a Hamas commander who participated in the October 7 massacre and an Islamic Jihad commander accused of continued attacks.

flash_692562.description: Staff Sgt. Adiv Mansour, one of the first to reach Kestelman after the shooting, testified that he too initially suspected he was a terrorist and the victim threw his wallet only after the shooting ended, at which point his identity became clear.

flash_692561.description: Arab activists accuse Smotrich of 'ethnic cleansing' and call on Arab public to mobilize voters to block Minister Smotrich’s plan to settle one million Jews and establish 40 new communities in the Negev and Galilee.

flash_692560.description: Bezalel Smotrich and Moshe Feiglin are negotiating a joint election run that could give Feiglin the No. 2 spot as Religious Zionism battles the threshold.

flash_692559.description: Ra'am MK Mansour Abbas urges increased Arab turnout, pledging to fight home demolitions, push for recognition of illegal Bedouin villages.

flash_692558.description: Report: Smotrich and Moshe Feiglin in talks to form technical bloc

flash_692557.description: Haredi protesters block Route 443, believing a draft evader was being detained, but police say he was arrested in a stolen car before his status was discovered.

flash_692556.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu calls for unity to save right-wing bloc, Otzma Yehudit declares decision to run separately 'final and absolute.'

flash_692555.description: When we rush to address problems before their time, even good intentions can produce harmful results and prevent much good.

flash_692554.description: Hundreds block Bar-Ilan intersection, damage infrastructure, as police deploy stun grenades and water cannons; two arrested.

flash_692553.description: A Jew remains responsible for another Jew even when they are not standing on the same mountain.

flash_692552.description: Irish man who allegedly told Jewish tourists Hitler should have 'finished the job' admits to his actions and will stand trial in October.

flash_692551.description: Two global stars, millions of followers and the same question: when Jews identify antisemitism, why does everyone else get to tell us we’re wrong? Opinion.

flash_692550.description: Groundbreaking bill would add 'Jewish' to ethnicity and race questions on state forms, drawing support from Jewish groups and warnings from opponents.

flash_692549.description: Less than a year after returning from 738 days in Hamas captivity, Elkana Bohbot and his wife Rivka celebrate the birth of their daughter.

flash_692548.description: The past tells us only how long we have already waited. It cannot tell us how quickly things may change.

flash_692547.description: Police issue safety warnings an unusual August storm is set to bring heavy rain, thunderstorms and flooding to parts of Israel.

flash_692546.description: When G-d wants you to compliment yourself

flash_692545.description: Two Israeli Arabs, including a 16-year-old, arrested after pledging allegiance to ISIS, planning attacks on Israeli security forces.

flash_692544.description: In a forest where Jews fought the Nazis, a German military base and Lithuanian politics encroach on memory.

flash_692543.description: A UK government spokesperson has stressed, "The UK is committed to the implementation of the 20-Point Plan in Gaza and playing our part in improving the situation on the ground. At the request of the United States and the Board of Peace, and because of that commitment to Gaza's future, we continue to work at IGSC with the US, Israel, international partners and UN agencies in support of UNSCR 2803. Removing the UK or other partners would undermine these shared efforts."

flash_692542.description: New Maariv poll gives Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar! 25 seats, while Ofer Winter's Amcha Yisrael crosses the threshold.

flash_692541.description: For a hundred and one reasons, most haredim will not join a non-hareidi institution and, therefore, they will not join the IDF as it is today. Opinion.

flash_692540.description: The one thing new money cannot buy is old money, so the people at an 1897 gala rented someone else’s past for the evening. It was ancestry as wishful thinking. Which brings me to the opening of Parshat Ki Tavo - the exact opposite.

flash_692539.description: UK's campaign against the Israeli “settlers" amounts to racist ethnic cleansing and Burnham's threatened boycott would affect all Israeli products. Israel might now suggest politely that since the UK apparently hates the Jewish state so much, it surely won’t want to benefit any further from Israeli intelligence or arms. Opinion. supplies.Opinion.

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:44 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_692577.description:
The Justice Department is appealing the dismissal of its antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard, seeking to revive a case involving nearly $1 billion.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692576.description:
Finland announces it will end its funding for UNRWA when its current agreement expires. Israel’s Foreign Ministry welcomes the move: UNRWA is a hotbed of terrorism.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692575.description:
Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei calls for national unity and stronger public morale as US economic pressure on Tehran intensifies.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692574.description:
Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem reiterates his rejection of the US-mediated Israel-Lebanon framework.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692573.description:
Gilad Erdan and Benny Gantz meet at Gantz’s home and agree to continue talks. Erdan stresses the need to first establish common principles, while Gantz presents his conditions for the alliance.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692572.description:
The US targets Banque Misr’s UAE branches over Iran-linked transactions as Washington expands sanctions aimed at cutting Tehran off from global finance.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692571.description:
Likud attacks Ben Gvir, claiming his refusal to unite with Smotrich could lead to lost right-wing votes and the formation of an Eisenkot-led government.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692570.description:
Four men plead guilty to arson attack that destroyed four Hatzolah ambulances in London, causing £1 million in damage.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 18:28 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 19:16 EDT candle lighting time in New York.

flash_692569.description: As part of the "Headstart Intelligence" project, haredi soldiers will undergo professional training, acquire a civilian profession, and will operate in a facility adapted to their way of life.

flash_692566.description:
US President Donald Trump published an AI-generated image showing him holding a rifle with explosions in the background, and wrote: “No more Mr. Nice Guy."

The post came amid the threats he directed at Iran at the time, after calling on Tehran to “come to its senses quickly" and reach an agreement on the nuclear issue.

גגכצילום: ההה

flash_692578.description: Two Hamas terrorists advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire, are eliminated in Gaza.

flash_692585.description: Rare late-August weather system brings strong winds and haze, with heavy rain and localized flooding possible in northern Israel.

flash_692584.description: Intelligence on a concrete threat prompted the urgent evacuation of the Prime Minister’s son from Florida to Israel under heavy security.

flash_692582.description: In an emotional interview, Omer Shem Tov, speaks of the guilt he still feels, his friendship with Uri Danino, the moment he surrendered himself to G-d deep inside the tunnel, and the dream he has embraced since returning home: to win an Oscar.

flash_692580.description: Clashes erupt in Qusra, Jalud, after Israelis begin to hit back following rock attack by local Arabs.

flash_692592.description: Iris Haim, whose son was accidentally killed in Gaza, says anger and revenge over the killing of an Israeli by IDF soldiers will only lead to more deaths.

flash_692591.description: New report says Palestinian Authority officials pushed Arab parties to unite against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud hits back.

flash_692589.description: Anti-Israel activist targeted one of three children near the Barkai neighborhood; residents detained the suspect until police arrived, Har Hevron Council says.

flash_692587.description: What started with a polite request to lower the volume allegedly ended with a violent assault, a police investigation, and a shaken guesthouse owner questioning whether he should have called police sooner.

flash_692583.description: Itamar Ben Gvir accuses Netanyahu and Smotrich of using a staged unity push to pressure Moshe Feiglin into lowering his demands for an electoral bloc.

flash_692581.description: At least 13 buses from northern Israel stopped as protesters block entrance to Jerusalem over public transportation operating on the Sabbath.

flash_692579.description: Hamas commander planning attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire, is eliminated while hiding in hospital.

flash_692593.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply criticizes the Attorney General over the controversy surrounding a memorial event for his father: “She is going after Maran, and this will not go unanswered."

flash_692588.description: Hundreds of trucks carrying food, medical supplies and water infrastructure equipment entered Gaza through Israel, while 150 residents departed for third countries, official data reveals.

flash_692586.description: More than NIS 200,000 in debt, a surprise 50th birthday party and an apartment left untouched: New details reveal what preceded Mali and Liel Yahalomi’s mysterious departure.
